name: Usage Ticker Reloaded
statusMeaning: Tried in the game with Kiln.
author: No_Namer
description: A lightweight client-side mod that shows the remaining count of the item you are holding in your inventory.

softOff.why: only events, HUD, keys, commands and guarded mixin handlers

works: Right of the hotbar (gui x 310, y 221) it draws the held item's icon with the total count of that item in the whole inventory (and in shulker boxes or bundles) when it isn't 1.
note: Not yet: its settings screen needs YACL
